params.name: start
params.description: ConceptNet URI for the subject (start) node of edges

params.name: end
params.description: ConceptNet URI for the object (end) node of edges

params.name: rel
params.description: Relation URI to filter by (e.g. /r/IsA or /r/UsedFor)

params.name: node
params.description: URI matching either the start or end position of edges. Cannot be combined with the "other" parameter using the same URI.

params.name: other
params.description: URI matching the position opposite to "node". Used together with "node" to find edges where node appears on one side and other appears on the other.

params.name: sources
params.description: Source URI to restrict results to a specific data source

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (0-100000)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (0-1000)

items.docs: Performs a complex query against the ConceptNet edge store using any combination of start, end, rel, node, other, and sources parameters. All parameters are optional but at least one must be provided. Results are returned as a paginated JSON-LD edge list. This is the most flexible endpoint for slicing the knowledge graph by subject, object, relation type, or data source simultaneously.
